notes: Seller/controller identity must be completed and explicitly verified against Brønnøysundregistrene before live checkout.
A checksum-valid organization number is only a format check and is never registry proof; registry_verification must match the approved legal name and organization number.
Policy, terms, privacy and withdrawal-information versions must be final and the policy status must be live_ready before checkout can open.
A valid durable-medium confirmation flow must be connected before service delivery begins.
Do not describe withdrawal right as lost merely because payment was authorized or captured; the service must be fully performed under the applicable rule.
